nodes.claim: For C=I-11^T/6 and balanced O=diag(-1,-1,-1,1,1,1), [C,O] has rank two and operator norm one.
The one-star physical convention is orient into a common frame before centering; the opposite order changes the covariance spectrum.
Typed square defects obey the exact telescoping composition identity and product-norm bound H6.1.
Adding a terminal recovery map yields the future-aware recovered transport inequality H6.2.
Accumulated recovered defects vanish under bounded prefixes, vanishing terminal recovery error, and summability or strict future contraction.
Both H6 covariance paths and all orientation permutations have a machine-checkable exact rational certificate.
One nonlinear gauge-covariant SU(2) block has a typed square defect with uniform boundary-history and support-indexed bounds.
The block tower preserves reflection positivity or has a uniformly bounded positive recovery theorem on the required observable core.
Recovered square defects are summable across repeated scales uniformly in volume and cutoff in physical units.
The resulting compatible family defines a nontrivial continuum pure Yang-Mills theory satisfying OS hypotheses.
The reconstructed physical Hamiltonian has the Clay-required positive mass gap.
